gamemechanicinfo-caveshrooms-text:
Caveshrooms
The world is in a constant state of flux, even far underground.

Unstable Substrate is the real organism - a slimy mat of unstable matter, thick with residual temporal instability, found deep underground. The Caveshroom mushroom is just its fruiting body.

Growth Cycle
A patch of substrate cycles through three states over time: Unstable Substrate, then Caveshroom Saddle, then finally Caveshroom. Harvesting a ripe caveshroom with a knife exchanges it back to bare substrate, ready to begin the cycle again - it never needs replanting.

Relocating
Unlike most mushrooms, the substrate itself can be dug up and carried. Break it (it always drops itself, regardless of growth state) and place it closer to a base to start a new patch. Breaking a ripe caveshroom instead of harvesting it still drops the mushroom too, knife or no knife.

Eating Temporal Mushrooms
Temporal Mushrooms are mildly poisonous and psychedelic - eat with some caution. Cooking dulls both effects the further it progresses, from raw through part-baked, perfect, and charred.

Cooking & Preparation
A Temporal Mushroom can be chopped with a knife or cleaver into Chopped Temporal Mushroom, or cooked whole over a fire - either form, raw or cooked, can be chopped or cooked further to reach the same set of results. Chopped Temporal Mushroom can also be baked into a Temporal Pie alongside pie dough.

Alchemy
If the Alchemy mod is installed, a Temporal Mushroom can be ground with a mortar and pestle alongside horsetail into a basic potion base.
